title: There is no better to date
text: Great product exceeds standard quantity design and just useful

title: Same Great Quality, New Great Color
text: We are no strangers to the Yeti brand, and my husband finally needed a new one to replace his old and loved one. He loved his old green one so I wanted to find him the same color. I found and liked this new green style, and the orange lid has surprisingly grown on my husband. We love it!

title: Yeti Tumblr
text: I think you’re definitely paying for the brand price is a little too high. I think it is a very good cup, but there are other brands out there that are just as good for less.

title: Great Tumbler
text: I got this for my husband and he is very impressed with how well insulated it is. This is a high quality cup that keeps drinks hot (or cold) for hours.

title: Quality is disappointing... Not the same as the older 'model'
text: Ok, I know everyone raves about the quality, and Yeti is the 'to go' product. HOWEVER, the quality of this new $35 purchase is not the same as my 2016 20oz Stainless Steel - not even close. There are two items I have lost in my travels these last few years (which I have had for 10+Yrs) - my Mink wrap scarf and my 2016 YETI! One was a cost issue, and the Yeti was my everyday cold water/ICE quality container (at hm and travelling) This newer model, just purchased, and within 20 minutes, I knew this was not the quality of the 2016 Yeti. 1) It is lighter 2) You can feel the temp (Cold) on the outside 3) It does not retain ICE - as expected. *my older version would have ice in the container the next morning. And the older lid did not have the slide cover. And this was an authorized Yeti seller, so as I know this new version is not a fake.

title: This yeti 20 oz cup-mug is well worth it!
text: This mug is definitely worth the price, the Lid, construction, the quality of stainless steel used is superior to the other mugs I used daily. Well worth the premium this 20 oz Yeti cup “mug”.

title: Drink Up!
text: It works to keep my morning coffee hot! Durable, and now I don’t need to make a second cup.

title: Broken and frustrated with Yeti
text: Received a clearly broken Yeti purchased before a vacation. Yeti has a needlessly elaborate return procedure after proving it is defective and then closes the return window.
